'''2001 SniderCon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG convention (unsanctioned) held in Normal, Illinois in September 2001. Frank won it. It is known from Al Schaefer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2984">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-23-i-won-the-beer-game-at-snidercon-2k1d2984/ i-won-the-beer-game-at-snidercon-2k1], DeckTech (Al "MoTU" Schaefer, 23 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-23-i-won-the-beer-game-at-snidercon-2k1d2984/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' September 2001
* '''Site:''' Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' Frank
